tooltips.cashBalance: Available company operating cash for payroll, rent, R&D, and marketing. Running out past your credit limit triggers bankruptcy.
tooltips.companyStatus: Quick snapshot of your company's current cash health and growth stage.
tooltips.speedPause: Pause simulation time so you can plan tasks and inspect the office (Space).
tooltips.speed1x: Run the daily workday simulation at standard speed (Key 1).
tooltips.speed3x: Accelerate the simulation to maximum 3x speed (Key 3).
tooltips.endDay: Immediately complete today's workday, applying product progress, customer revenue, and team stamina updates.
tooltips.navOffice: Return to the interactive office map to watch employees and inspect rooms or desks.
tooltips.navEmployees: Manage your team roster, assign tasks, train skills, promote staff, and hire new candidates.
tooltips.navProducts: Create product ideas, run R&D sprints, fix bugs, launch MVPs, and raise product quality.
tooltips.navFinance: Track cash runway, monthly burn, credit line usage, and adjust your Founder salary.
tooltips.navMarket: Launch marketing campaigns to grow active users and negotiate B2B client contracts.
tooltips.navUpgrades: Expand office HQ capacity, unlock new departments, and install morale-boosting perks.
tooltips.navMilestones: View company growth milestones and unlocked achievements.
tooltips.navSaveLoad: Save your current progress to slots or load an earlier save.
tooltips.navTutorial: Reopen the step-by-step interactive guide at any time.
tooltips.navSettings: Switch display language, adjust TTS voice-over, audio volume, and view keyboard shortcuts.
tooltips.empSkill: Primary role skill that directly drives task speed and output quality.
tooltips.empOutput: Effective daily productivity calculated from skill mastery, morale, energy, and role fit.
tooltips.empMorale: Team spirit and motivation. High morale boosts output; low morale risks burnout resignation.
tooltips.empEnergy: Remaining daily stamina. Fatigued employees slow down unless supported by rest or office perks.
tooltips.empStress: Accumulated workload pressure. Sustained high stress drains morale and triggers resignation warnings.
tooltips.empTaskSelect: Assign a daily focus matching this employee's strongest skill for peak efficiency.
tooltips.empProductSelect: Choose which active product this employee contributes their daily work toward.
tooltips.financeCompanyCash: Operating capital used for R&D, campaigns, and Day 30 monthly payroll and rent.
tooltips.financeProjectedNet: Estimated monthly net profit or burn based on recurring revenue minus payroll, rent, and upkeep.
tooltips.financePersonalCash: Your personal savings accumulated from your monthly Founder salary draw.
tooltips.financeCreditDebt: Current borrowed balance against your credit line. Exceeding the limit on month close causes bankruptcy.
tooltips.financeApplySalary: Apply the selected Founder salary. Lower draws boost team respect and investor trust; lavish draws reduce both.

intro.s1Text: Every great company once started from a very small place...
intro.s2Text: You have a small office, some hard-earned savings, and an idea.
intro.readyDay1: {company} opens its doors for Day 1. Time to write your first chapter.

c1.title: First Day
c1.theme: A small beginning — discovering the office, the team, and who you want to become.

c2.title: First Product
c2.theme: Turning a raw sketch into software real people can use.
c2.milestone: Complete and launch the first product prototype.

c3.title: First Customer
c3.theme: Finding the first people who trust your product and hearing their honest feedback.

c4.title: Growing Pains
c4.theme: Momentum brings real tension between expenses, workload, quality, and culture.
c4.milestone: Navigate the company's first major growth challenge.

c5.title: Big Opportunity
c5.theme: Investors, competitors, and buyout offers force a defining strategic choice.

c6.title: Future of Company
c6.theme: Looking back at everything you built — and what kind of company you created.
c6.milestone: Evaluate the journey and reach your ending.

milestones.c1Line1: The coffee machine hums to life as keyboards begin to click across your starter room.
milestones.c1Line2: We finally have a real direction. Let's ship something worth believing in.
milestones.c2Line1: Our first prototype is live! Real users can sign in today.
milestones.c2Line2: What started as late-night sketches now lives out in the world.
milestones.c3Line1: The first invoice just cleared — someone paid for what this small team built.
milestones.c3Line2: One customer turned an idea into a real business. Now we earn their trust every day.
milestones.c4Line1: More desks, deeper ambitions, and tougher trade-offs test your leadership.
milestones.c4Line2: Growing fast is easy to dream about; growing healthy takes courage.
milestones.c5Line1: Word has spread across the industry. Bigger doors are opening ahead.
milestones.c5Line2: From here on, every decision defines what our company truly stands for.
milestones.c6Line1: Looking out over the office, every empty mug and milestone tells your story.
milestones.c6Line2: This is the company we built together — and the future waiting beyond today.

ch1Identity.title: Chapter 1 · Company Identity
ch1Identity.desc: As {company} settles into its opening week, the three founding teammates ask what core value should guide your young studio.
ch1Identity.c1Desc: Set high technical standards from day one, even if shipping takes patience.
ch1Identity.c2Desc: Prioritize speed and early experimentation above comfort.
ch1Identity.c3Desc: Build a supportive, sustainable studio where teammates thrive together.

ch2Direction.title: Chapter 2 · Early Product Direction
ch2Direction.desc: {product} is taking shape in Engineering. Before locking in the first release, choose how the team focuses its energy.
ch2Direction.c1Desc: Invest in resilient infrastructure and lasting product quality.
ch2Direction.c2Desc: Polish onboarding and ease of use so early adopters love day one.

ch3Feedback.title: Chapter 3 · Candid Customer Feedback
ch3Feedback.desc: Your first real users sent thoughtful notes about rough edges in {product}. How do you respond?
ch3Feedback.c1Desc: Listen closely, patch bugs, and delight early believers.
ch3Feedback.c2Desc: Accept rough edges for now to convert more trials immediately.
ch3Feedback.c3Desc: Run outreach campaigns alongside gradual fixes to bring in new users.

ch4Workload.title: Chapter 4 · The Weight of Growth
ch4Workload.desc: Deadlines are piling up and {employee} looks exhausted from carrying extra sprint pressure. What do you do?
ch4Workload.c1Desc: Trim non-urgent scope and give the team breathing room.
ch4Workload.c2Desc: Bring on a new teammate immediately to share the load.
ch4Workload.c2Effects: +1 Teammate (if desk space allows) · +12 Morale · -15 Stress · +8 Culture
ch4Workload.c3Desc: Squeeze out extra short-term delivery and revenue at a human cost.

ch4Expansion.title: Chapter 4 · Space to Grow
ch4Expansion.desc: Desks are getting cozy as {company} matures. How will you allocate your hard-earned surplus?
ch4Expansion.c1Desc: Add room capacity, nicer comfort, and stronger brand presence.
ch4Expansion.c2Desc: Stay lean and fortify reserves before taking on higher fixed costs.
ch4Expansion.c3Desc: Upgrade team wellness, coffee perks, and morale instead of square footage.

ch5Investment.title: Chapter 5 · Venture Capital Offer
ch5Investment.desc: A prominent tech fund is ready to back {company} as you enter the big leagues.
ch5Investment.c1Desc: Take the capital immediately to fuel rapid hiring and market capture.
ch5Investment.c2Desc: Hold firm at the table to protect founder ownership and culture.
ch5Investment.c3Desc: Keep full control and grow purely on customer trust.

ch5Acquisition.title: Chapter 5 · Major Acquisition Offer
ch5Acquisition.desc: An industry giant wants to acquire {company} at a {amount} valuation. Will you sell or keep building independently?
ch5Acquisition.c1Desc: Close a celebrated exit for founders, investors, and the team (Triggers Acquisition Ending).
ch5Acquisition.c1Effects: Company acquired at {amount} · Unlocks Ending C
ch5Acquisition.c2Desc: Turn down the buyout and lead your team into Chapter 6 independently.

ch6Horizon.title: Chapter 6 · Future of the Company
ch6Horizon.desc: {founder}, look back at every late night, breakthrough, and teammate beside you. What final chapter defines {company}?
ch6Horizon.c1Desc: Empower senior teammates and cement the values that carried you here.
ch6Horizon.c2Desc: Push revenue and customer reach to their peak before the final evaluation.

DREAM_COMPANY.title: Ending A: The Dream Company
DREAM_COMPANY.tagline: Thriving products, happy people, and a studio you are proud to walk into.
DREAM_COMPANY.message: You built the very thing that on Day 1 you only dared to dream about.
DREAM_COMPANY.hint: Reach strong valuation/cash, live products, high reputation, and satisfied staff.
DREAM_COMPANY.s1: The expanded office buzzes with laughter, glowing monitors, and shipping milestones.
DREAM_COMPANY.s2: From three desks and cardboard boxes to an admired tech studio — we made it together.

SMALL_BUT_HAPPY.title: Ending B: Small But Happy
SMALL_BUT_HAPPY.message: You do not need to become the biggest company to have a journey worth being proud of.
SMALL_BUT_HAPPY.hint: Keep finances stable with a compact team, high morale, and healthy culture.
SMALL_BUT_HAPPY.s1: Warm sunlight pours across the cozy office while teammates share fresh morning coffee.
SMALL_BUT_HAPPY.s2: Every customer knows us by name, and nobody wants to trade this team for the world.

ACQUISITION.title: Ending C: The Acquisition
ACQUISITION.tagline: A triumphant exit and a bittersweet farewell.
ACQUISITION.message: Sometimes, the end of one journey is also the beginning of another.
ACQUISITION.hint: Accept the major Acquisition offer during Chapter 5.
ACQUISITION.s1: Press releases announce the acquisition across tech headlines as champagne glasses clink.
ACQUISITION.s2: Thank you for trusting us from Day 1. Wherever we go next, we started here.

BURNOUT.title: Ending D: Burnout
BURNOUT.tagline: Impressive numbers on paper, silence in the hallways.
BURNOUT.message: You built a company. But do you still want to work there?
BURNOUT.hint: Grow to high valuation or revenue while morale, retention, and culture collapse.
BURNOUT.s1: Midnight settles over empty desks while notifications still glow on one lonely screen.
BURNOUT.s2: The metrics climbed every quarter, yet almost everyone who cared has already left.

LAST_DAY.title: Ending E: The Last Day
LAST_DAY.tagline: The lights dim, but the lessons endure.
LAST_DAY.message: Not every idea succeeds. Yet every journey leaves something behind.
LAST_DAY.hint: Occurs when insolvency leaves no viable financial recovery path.
LAST_DAY.s1: Cardboard boxes return to the desks where dreams once unpacked on a bright morning.
LAST_DAY.s2: We gave it everything we had. See you on the next venture, founder.

LEGACY.title: Ending F: Legacy
LEGACY.tagline: A company built to outlast its founder.
LEGACY.message: What you leave behind is not just a company, but the people and what they will keep building.
LEGACY.hint: Sustain elite long-term valuation, high product quality, high morale, strong culture, and near-zero turnover.
LEGACY.s1: Years later, a new generation gathers around the whiteboard under warm golden light.
LEGACY.s2: Your founding teammates now mentor new builders, carrying the studio spirit forward.

endingCard.confirmNewGameBody: Start a brand-new company? Your unlocked Ending Gallery stays saved, while this completed run will remain in manual slots.

PRODUCT_MVP_LAUNCH.title: {subject} Is Live!
PRODUCT_MVP_LAUNCH.line: Cheers echo across Engineering — {count} first paying customers are already onboard!

PRODUCT_MATURE_RELEASE.title: {subject} Reaches v{version}.0!
PRODUCT_MATURE_RELEASE.line: Your flagship product is now Mature. The whole team celebrates the craft behind it!

HQ_EXPANSION.title: Welcome to {subject}!
HQ_EXPANSION.line: More room, brighter desks, and fresh energy as {company} steps into a bigger chapter.

DEPARTMENT_EXPANSION.title: {subject} Unlocked!
DEPARTMENT_EXPANSION.line: A brand-new wing opens its doors — teammates gather to celebrate the expansion.
